title: Silence in Herat and Kabul: A Story of Change, Fear, and Hope
description: In “Silence in Herat and Kabul: A Story of Change, Fear, and Hope,” by Razia Hussaini, an EmpowerHer student, the writer offers a powerful reflection on the realities faced by Afghan women and girls under increasing restrictions. Through a personal perspective, the piece captures the fear, silence, and uncertainty experienced in Kabul and Herat while highlighting the resilience, courage, and enduring hope of those who continue to dream despite oppression.
